verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing page names an audit trail as a product capability. That is the right capability, but the evidence is a single thin marketing line. Nothing documents an admin-facing log, its workspace-wide scope, what actions it records, or how it is reviewed. missing for 10: documentation of an admin audit log UI, workspace-wide coverage of recorded actions, filtering/export or retention details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can review an admin audit log of actions taken across the workspace

citations.quote: Stay in control with an audit trail that keeps teams and agents moving faster and in the same direction.
